wiki.title: Ethan Corson
wiki.extract: Ethan Corson (born 1982) is an American politician and attorney who represents the 7th district in the Kansas Senate. Elected in 2020, he assumed office on January 11, 2021. A member of the Democratic Party, he ran for governor of Kansas in the 2026 election, but lost to Cindy Holscher in the Democratic primary.
